mapper.select: SELECT FROM project_model_configs WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND (scope='TEAM' OR created_by=#{userId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE') ORDER BY (CASE WHEN created_by=#{userId} AND scope='PERSONAL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), updated_at DESC

SELECT FROM project_model_configs WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND enabled=TRUE AND (scope='TEAM' OR created_by IN (#{creatorId}, #{userId})) ORDER BY CASE WHEN created_by=#{creatorId} AND scope='PERSONAL' THEN 0 WHEN created_by=#{creatorId} AND scope='TEAM' THEN 1 WHEN created_by=#{userId} AND scope='PERSONAL' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, updated_at DESC

SELECT FROM project_model_configs WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND (scope='TEAM' OR created_by=#{userId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE project_model_configs SET name=#{name},provider=#{provider},model_id=#{modelId},endpoint=#{endpoint},auth_type=#{authType},credential_ciphertext=COALESCE(#{credentialCiphertext},credential_ciphertext),config=CAST(#{config} AS jsonb),enabled=#{enabled},scope=#{scope},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_model_configs WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId}
